findings.message: The asset manifest ships a literal "Replace with the real inventory" placeholder claiming art, audio and level data live under assets/. The game renders everything procedurally through Keystone primitives and bundles no such assets, so the license manifest misstates what is offered and leaves an unfilled scaffold note in a shipped document.
findings.evidence: | `assets/` | art, audio, level data | AegeanWorks | AGL-1.1 | Replace with the real inventory |
findings.patch_old: | `assets/` | art, audio, level data | AegeanWorks | AGL-1.1 | Replace with the real inventory |
findings.patch_new: | `assets/screenshots/` | gameplay screenshots | AegeanWorks | AGL-1.1 | Player captures; all game visuals are rendered procedurally, no bundled art or audio |

findings.message: The inventory advertises a "handler|run|demo-run" control but no demo-run handler exists anywhere in the project, and the real keyboard controls are absent. The inventory is the project-owned control manifest, so it should list the controls the game actually binds.
findings.patch_new:
print('key|start|space')
    print('key|restart|r')
    print('key|course|f')
    print('key|ghost|g')
    print('key|pause|p')
    print('key|boost|left_shift')
    print('axis|forward|w/s')
    print('axis|steer|a/d')
